subject.title: [Refactor] Consolidate synthetic log formats across MCP service pipelines

question: Should OpenClaw tools and Codex supervision MCP diagnostics intentionally share one stable format contract, or remain independently owned formats?
rationale: Duplication alone does not establish that these core and plugin-owned pipelines have the same diagnostic semantics, and repository architecture policy requires an explicit neutral boundary before coupling them.

options.title: Keep owner-specific formats
options.body: Preserve separate formatters and add focused tests or documentation for each pipeline unless a concrete observable mismatch is reported.

options.title: Define a shared contract
options.body: Specify the common fields, redaction, severity, and compatibility expectations, then expose a neutral formatter seam usable by both owners.

recommendation.title: Keep owner-specific formats
recommendation.body: Preserve separate formatters and add focused tests or documentation for each pipeline unless a concrete observable mismatch is reported.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history connects this person to the original OpenClaw MCP bridge and the current Codex supervision surface.
